title: Jagged Paneer Rasmalai
description: A twist on the classic Indian dessert, Jagged Paneer Rasmalai combines the creaminess of rasmalai with the tanginess of paneer. A perfect dessert for those looking for a unique flavor combination.
instructions: Soak the jagged in milk for 30 minutes.
Drain the milk and grind the jagged into a smooth paste.
Cut the paneer into small cubes.
Heat the rasmalai in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sugar, cardamom, and saffron to the rasmalai.
Bring the mixture to a boil and then reduce the heat.
Add the paneer cubes to the rasmalai mixture.
Simmer for 5-7 minutes or until the paneer is fully coated.
Serve the Jagged Paneer Rasmalai warm or chilled.
